headline: Mitsotakis: The pre-election dilemma with development as the 'vehicle' – Incomes, cost of living and reforms at the forefront
summary: Mitsotakis is charting the path to the 2027 polls, focusing on high growth, raising wages and disposable income, and supporting households against high living costs.
why: Greece's economic policy, wage levels and household finances shape its sovereign debt outlook and investor confidence. Pre-election policy direction can signal future fiscal and reform decisions.
